status: 296 source definitions updated across 87 original files; build and 15,169 fixed entry slots pass. 309 trigger-name substitutions in 280 definitions are separate from 18 scoped-flow reviews; seven complete strict CFG comparisons match.

source_reviews.name: card_sunder_shaman
source_reviews.reason: Restore native APNAP p/macro_apnap scopes, separate packed hit counts from player coordinates and preserve post-action target reset on both passes. current_turn is reread at the second pass after callbacks, not snapshotted across both players. Preserve one trigger action per nonzero packed player count.

source_reviews.name: card_explore_the_vastlands
source_reviews.reason: Restore native APNAP p/macro_apnap and selected. Keep the initial test initialized only once, including its native mutation carried into the second player pass. Preserve selected-card query before second test initialization, saved p across chooser/life callbacks, fresh current_turn on next pass, source kill and basic-spell continuation.

source_reviews.name: rushed_rebirth_legacy
source_reviews.reason: Restore native scoped inst/p/c/affected/num/mv/result rather than reusing value and controller_or_cmc. Keep initial coordinates for removal/getter, fresh attached coordinates after that getter, per-field record stores, CMC before live creature query, and separate GFP resolution plus cleanup kills. Signed nonzero do-loop and native kill-code byte test remain.

source_reviews.name: card_mana_web
source_reviews.reason: Restore native color/p/c/test roles and remove shared colors_count_or_result. Keep initial getter, opponent snapshot, land before humiliation, color query before test, optional setting query, reentrancy marker and ordered test/ID conversion/autotap with live active bound. The native initial active-count read may precede the marker write; they are nonvolatile disjoint engine/card-record fields without a callback between them.

source_reviews.name: card_arcane_signet
source_reviews.reason: Separate scan count, primary IID, partner IID and commander pointer. Restore native count name; semantic IID names correspond to DWARF fake1/fake2 without reusing a scan index. Preserve live info_slot after each remainder-color callback and partner IID read after the first callback, no new primary-IID guard, live active bound and final mana continuation.

source_reviews.name: card_rogue_skycaptain
source_reviews.reason: Restore native count/amount/choice and separate humiliation, upkeep count and dialog/payment results. Keep count snapshot, counter-add/count, mana guard then dialog and conditional charge, exact fizzle==1 and native same-player give_control arguments on failure. No printed-card rules fix.

source_reviews.name: card_elder_mastery
source_reviews.reason: Restore native APNAP p/macro_apnap, removing packed-count/turn-player reuse. The first player stays fixed across its discard loop; the second player is selected from fresh current_turn after those callbacks. First-slot decrements remain visible if the second pass selects the same player. Extra final writes to the private second slot are dead and unobservable; no pointer to the local array escapes.

source_reviews.name: card_cry_of_the_carnarium
source_reviews.reason: Restore two distinct native APNAP p/macro_apnap/c scopes. Each player gets a reverse starting-count snapshot; no forward/live-bound conversion. Native cached current_turn reads inside the first scan are consumed only at the next player/phase boundary; APNAP reads the same live value there after callbacks. Keep exile-marking phase before all pumps, then grave exile, legacy, source kill and generic continuation.

source_reviews.name: card_dauthi_warlord
source_reviews.reason: Restore native p/pt/count and ordered live battlefield scans. In-play precedes shadow query; normalized nonzero contribution preserves the native ADD/SUB boolean count and final PT setter. No humiliation or other new rule checks.

source_reviews.name: card_aethersnatch
source_reviews.reason: Restore native spell/iid/card_added and separate validity/mode/controller roles. Keep two CAST getters; mode reread after one-target deflection can still cause multi-target deflection in the same resolution. IID is saved before obliteration, target fields stay live after deflections, and controller is read only after put_into_play before native owner-state writes.

source_reviews.name: has_only_1_target_and_can_legally_change_target_to_attached
source_reviews.reason: Restore native spell/targeting/attached coordinates/prev_9/rvalue roles and separate target coordinate from callback result. Use native target_t snapshot instead of two scalar stack-slot stand-ins. Disjoint field reads/writes without intervening callbacks may be scheduled differently; set flag, card callback, full target restore, remove flag and rejection strings retain order.

source_reviews.name: count_different_mana_values_among_card_exiled_with_study_counter
source_reviews.reason: Restore native zero-initialized manacosts[20], mc/c/inst/cmc scopes, removing shared zeroing/count index and pointer cursor. Keep in-play/type/fresh-getter/callback-identity/study-counter/CMC order, live target IID after count callback and live active bound. Native unchecked CMC indexing remains; no new capacity rule.

source_reviews.name: count_how_many_times_a_commander_was_played
source_reviews.reason: Restore native edh_card/amount and separate second counter result from card coordinate. Keep sentinel guard, VORTEX then VELOCITY queries, first count snapshot across second callback and two signed divisions before addition.

source_reviews.name: card_vances_blasting_cannons
source_reviews.reason: Restore native csvid and separate storm-count predicate from trigger mode. Keep CSVID snapshot before exile, native CSVID-as-IID is_what argument and missing empty-deck guard, storm query before duh choice and spell trigger; global enchantment behavior remains canonical.

source_reviews.name: card_pteramander
source_reviews.reason: Restore native cless and canonical four-event filter, replacing compiler result-zero guard scaffolding. Preserve grave query then cost subtraction and adapt packet, including native negative colorless costs.

source_reviews.name: card_sol_talisman
source_reviews.reason: Express the native four activation events plus COUNT_MANA route directly, keeping every other event routed to suspend_only. No new spell/resolution route or result-register requirement.

source_reviews.name: card_dauthi_cutthroat
source_reviews.reason: Share native four-event setup while preserving shadow before filter, target definition/callback/getter order and ACTIVATE-only flags-seven literal prompt return. Other activation events retain flags-five/null prompt, with validation before live target kill.

source_reviews.name: card_ancestral_knowledge
source_reviews.reason: Restore native deck/amount/selected, separate initial deck count from picker result and share one leaves-play continuation. The ten-card cap preserves the initial nonzero predicate; deck pointer remains saved before count callback. Keep exile/decrement/picker order, rearrange before leaves_play, then leave-ability shuffle and enchantment tail.

symbolic_trigger_restoration.scope: Equal-valued C enum-name substitution only for the 278 pure definitions. A literal spelling change is not a new native function/body review. Two overlapping functions also have independently reviewed control-flow restoration.
